TARGET_DECL Shao.sourceTruncation_noise_badClock_weighted_cost KIND theorem AXIOMS [propext,
 Classical.choice,
 Quot.sound]

values: A=intersection of all closed cutoff coordinate events

mathematical_review.finding: epsilon<=1/800 pays <=1/2, <=1/8, <=1; 1+x>0 and R>=0; exact sandwich conjunctions give integrability and E delta<=400 gamma.
Exact conditional gamma and m3 interfaces yield gamma<=2*n*m3 and n*m3<=2*R/(1+x)^3; nonnegative multiplication gives E delta<=1600*R/(1+x)^3.
x>=0 gives 1+x<=(1+x)^3; R>=0 justifies division comparison. Actual Gaussian density nonnegative and actual Mills phi/(1+x)<=tail give weighted noise<=1600*R*tail.

Genuine product nu^n coordinates are measurable, independent and each identically distributed with nu. Exact conditioned-sample pushforward has samplePath=id, giving equality of entire conditioned measure mux=P.
The third final-clock conjunct is the same actual energy-bad event under mux. Rewrite mux=P, add the proved weighted noise cost, and ring exactly gives the frozen literal constant.
